This quest gives [[Ritualist]]s access to the [[Shing Jea Monastery]] and introduces the ritualist headmaster, [[Headmaster Quin|Quin]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Ritualist
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to [[Ludo]] to gain entrance to the monastery.
* Seek out [[Headmaster Quin]] in the monastery.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the following [[skill]]s:
* {{skill icon|Pain}}
* {{skill icon|Weapon of Warding}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
You also gain 2,000 experience, and acquire [[Starter Ritualist Wand]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Quin, who is nearby, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ludo
:''Oooh, a new Ritualist! Welcome! You should seek out [[Headmaster Quin]] in the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. She and her staff will provide your training. Good luck!''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Quin.
| decline = I'm going to have a quick look around, first.
| ask = I told [[Headmaster Quin]] of your arrival, and she is most anxious to meet you. You will find her in the monastery.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Quin
:''Ludo told me you had arrived. Welcome.''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
